meta.title: Overwatch 2 Sensitivity Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert any game's sensitivity to Overwatch 2. Enter DPI and source sens for instant results.
sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
cm360Desc: Distance your mouse must travel for one full 360° rotation
steps_overwatch2-sensitivity-converter_1: Input your OW2 sensitivity from Options → Controls → Mouse → Sensitivity. Note your FOV setting as it affects the conversion.
steps_overwatch2-sensitivity-converter_2: Choose the destination game. Overwatch 2's faster pace and vertical aim requirements mean the converted sensitivity may need minor adjustment.
steps_overwatch2-sensitivity-converter_3: Apply the converted sensitivity in your target game. Spend time in practice range adjusting to the different game feel and movement speed.
